user.title: What do you want to connect?

pv.title: Connect a PV plant
pv.description: Add the integration once per plant. The plant token is under “Show token” in the plant's Integrations tab on wabenwatt.de. A first report is sent right away, so the plant shows up as active within two minutes.

data_description.name: Shown in Home Assistant, e.g. the plant's name on wabenwatt.
data_description.api_token: Identifies the plant; every token belongs to exactly one plant.
data_description.pv_sensors: The plant's total solar power. Plug-in solar (micro inverter): the AC value. String or hybrid inverters: the DC power of the strings — not the AC value, which for hybrid systems also contains the battery output. No total entity? Select one entity per string; the values are added up.
data_description.battery_sensor: Only for plants with separate battery metering (hybrid inverter): the battery's power, which is not part of the DC value above. Otherwise leave empty — then only the solar power is reported.
data_description.battery_invert: Wabenwatt expects positive = discharging. Enable this if your sensor is positive while charging.

reauth_confirm.title: Renew plant token
reauth_confirm.description: The token of “{name}” was rejected (unknown or revoked). Enter the plant's current token from wabenwatt.de.

error.invalid_token: The plant token was rejected — copy it again from “Show token” on wabenwatt.de.
error.sensor_unavailable: {entity_id} has no numeric value right now (unavailable/unknown). Choose a sensor that currently delivers a value.
error.sensor_not_power: {entity_id} is not a power sensor (unit: {unit}). Choose a sensor in W or kW.
error.battery_not_supported: This plant is not set up for separate battery metering on wabenwatt. Leave the battery sensor empty or change the plant's settings first.
error.rate_limited: wabenwatt is rate limiting this plant. Wait a minute and try again.
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach reports.wabenwatt.de. Check the internet connection and try again.

abort.already_configured: A plant with this token is already set up.
